_doc: H-13 / DSCH-25 — USP <797> / <800> pharmacy cleanroom cascade. The ONE owner of these limits; read by
Core/Validation/Healthcare/UspCascade.cs (PharmacyUspAuditCommand, PressureRegimeValidator). No code constant backs them.
Differentials are in inches of water column as USP states them; Pa is derived (1 in w.c. = 249.0889 Pa).
roomClass is the CLN_ROOM_CLASS_TXT value a row audits (DSCH-36: every row has one). A suite is the primary class
(PH-CSP-797 buffer room, PH-CSP-800 C-SEC) plus the classes that extend it (-ANTE ante-room, -CSCA containment
segregated compounding area); the pharmacy audit checks the whole suite of the selected standard.
This file is the one owner of PH-CSP-* polarity, differential and air changes: HTMStandards and ASHRAE170Standards
Every figure carries a 'verify' text: the values were confirmed from secondary sources, not the official USP text.
description: USP <797> / <800> pharmacy cleanroom pressure cascade and air-change minimums.
